description: Component for polling a local webhook inbox JSONL file for new callbacks.

inbox_path.label: Inbox Path
inbox_path.description: Path to the JSONL inbox file written by webhook_inbox_receiver. Must be the same path/filesystem the receiver's --inbox-path points at.

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Name of the job to trigger when a webhook callback arrives

op_name.label: Op Name
op_name.description: Op name the webhook payload is delivered to via run_config: {'ops': {op_name: {'config': {...}}}}. Defaults to 'config'.

minimum_interval_seconds.label: Minimum Interval Seconds
minimum_interval_seconds.description: Minimum time (in seconds) between sensor evaluations

max_events_per_tick.label: Max Events Per Tick
max_events_per_tick.description: Maximum number of new inbox lines to turn into RunRequests in a single evaluation. Caps how much work one tick does after a large backlog; the remainder is picked up on the next tick.

partition_mode.label: Partition Mode
partition_mode.description: How a new webhook event is surfaced to downstream assets: 'run_config' (default) yields RunRequest with the event in run_config; 'dynamic_partition' registers event_id_field's value (or a content hash fallback) as a dynamic partition. Requires dynamic_partitions_name.

dynamic_partitions_name.label: Dynamic Partitions Name
dynamic_partitions_name.description: Required when partition_mode is 'dynamic_partition'. Must match the downstream asset's dynamic partition definition name.

event_id_field.label: Event Id Field
event_id_field.description: Dotted-path key (e.g. 'job.id') looked up in each webhook payload to use as a dedupe/partition key. Falls back to a stable hash of the full payload when absent from a given payload.

default_status.label: Default Status
default_status.description: Default status of the sensor (running or stopped)

name: Webhook Inbox Sensor
